generated.description: A large, streamlined hovering vehicle built mostly from gray wool and gray terracotta, with white terracotta accents and black stained glass windows along its sides. It is about 47 blocks wide, 9 high and 50 deep, with a tapered, sloped hull that gets thicker toward the middle and narrows to a point at the nose. Inside it has a few interactive details such as chests, a jukebox, a record player, beacons, and redstone levers and pressure plates.
